review.alternative: Coordination might emerge entirely from implicit environmental feedback without explicit architectural dimensions.
review.would_change_mind: Empirical demonstration that multi-agent teams achieve stable coordination without communication across defined architectural channels.

claims.statement: Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning systems employ structured communication across nine architectural dimensions to manage information exchange and improve joint coordination.

support.explanation: The source establishes a nine-dimensional classification framework for communication in multi-agent deep reinforcement learning.
support.passage: In this paper, we survey recent works in the Comm-MADRL field and consider various aspects of communication that can play a role in designing and developing multi-agent reinforcement learning systems. With these aspects in mind, we propose 9 dimensions along which Comm-MADRL approaches can be analyzed, developed, and compared.

actions.findings: Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning systems employ structured communication across nine architectural dimensions to manage information exchange and improve joint coordination. [source-f1bf48f86f624ed9]
actions.limitations: Findings reflect high-level architectural surveys rather than direct empirical measurements of long-term agent preference stability.
actions.next_questions: How do specific architectural communication dimensions experimentally influence the trajectory of agent behavior over extended training horizons?
actions.reason: Revising project notebook to integrate newly verified survey evidence regarding multi-agent communication dimensions.
actions.summary: Synthesized survey findings on multi-agent reinforcement learning communication dimensions and architectural mechanisms for joint coordination, incorporating source-f1bf48f86f624ed9.
